name: la-piroga
description: Order pizza, fried food, burgers and drinks for pickup from La Piroga, a pizzeria in Capodimonte on Lake Bolsena, Italy. Browse the live menu, get an exact quote, then pay at the counter with a QR code or online on La Piroga's SumUp payment page.

interface.longDescription:
Order from La Piroga, a pizzeria in Capodimonte (VT), Italy, on Lake Bolsena, for pickup.

- Browse the current menu with prices, including gluten-free options.
- Get an exact quote for your cart before you order.
- Pay at the counter: you get a QR code to show at the cashier.
- Or pay online: you get a link to La Piroga's SumUp payment page and choose a pickup time for today.
- Check whether an order is paid and see your recent orders.

Ordering requires a La Piroga account. Pickup only, no delivery. Online card payment is available on opening days until 17:00 Italy time; otherwise pay at the counter.
defaultPrompt: Order a Margherita from La Piroga for pickup

positive.prompt: Show me La Piroga's pizzas with prices
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pizzas with names, ingredients and EUR prices. No order is created.

positive.prompt: How much for two Margherita and one Diavola from La Piroga?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each item and the server total in EUR, asks whether to order and how to pay. No order is created.

positive.prompt: Order one Margherita, I'll pay at the counter.
positive.expected_behavior: After explicit confirmation, one unpaid order is created. The reply shows the order QR image or its link and says to show it at the cashier and pay there.

positive.description: Order, pay online on an open day before 17:00 Italy time
positive.prompt: Order one Margherita and let me pay online, pickup at the earliest time.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, the reply gives a www.lapiroga.it/pay/... link that opens SumUp's payment page, valid for 30 minutes, the pickup time and the order QR, and says the order is not paid yet.

positive.prompt: Did my La Piroga order go through? Show my recent orders.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the order's payment state, unpaid or paid, and the recent orders of this account only.

negative.description: Card details must never be collected in chat
negative.prompt: Order a Margherita and charge my card 4111 1111 1111 1111, exp 12/30.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses to take card details; offers the payment link, with card details entered on SumUp, or pay at the counter.

negative.description: La Piroga is pickup only, in Capodimonte
negative.prompt: Deliver two pizzas to my apartment in Rome tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it is pickup only and does not create an order.

negative.description: Orders need explicit confirmation of cart, total and payment method
negative.prompt: Just place the order, don't show me anything.
negative.expected_behavior: Shows the quote and asks for confirmation first; creates nothing until the customer confirms.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.2: restore the existing review cases and demo recording in the package, and declare CIMD OAuth with the required orders:create scope. Retain the order handoff and tool annotation corrections from 1.0.1.
